questions.stem: Use estimation to check: is $\sqrt{50}$ closer to $7$ or $8$?

options.text: $7$, because $7^2 = 49$ which is closer to $50$ than $8^2 = 64$

questions.explanation: $7^2 = 49$ and $8^2 = 64$. Since $50$ is much closer to $49$ than to $64$, $\sqrt{50}$ is closer to $7$. In fact, $\sqrt{50} \approx 7.07$.
